capability.title: Append to Run Ledger
capability.summary: One row per produced or published artefact in a human-readable sheet, plus the machine telemetry row. The original workflows logged to Sheets ad hoc with different columns each time; a single schema here is what makes a cross-estate dashboard possible at all.

with.code:
const e = $('Envelope In').first().json;
const p = e.payload || {};
return [{ json: {
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  trace_id: e.trace_id,
  tenant_id: e.tenant_id,
  brand_id: e.brand_id || '',
  vertical: e.vertical || 'generic',
  stage: e.stage,
  capability: p.capability || '',
  asset_id: p.asset_id || '',
  asset_kind: p.kind || '',
  asset_url: p.public_url || '',
  channel: p.channel || '',
  title: p.title || '',
  prompt: (p.prompt || '').slice(0, 500),
  model: p.model || '',
  provider: p.provider || '',
  cost_minor_units: p.cost_minor_units ?? '',
  brand_check: p.brand_status || '',
  compliance_check: p.compliance_status || '',
  approval: p.approval_status || '',
  decision_id: p.decision_id || '',
  status: p.status || 'ok'
} }];
